thread:
sam_jensen: Hey @support, our /rerank calls started failing with a 413 Payload Too Large today after a deploy. It only happens for a small subset of users with very long queries + big doc arrays. Example payload size ~1.6MB. Response: {"error":"413 Request Entity Too Large","message":"input token ceiling exceeded"}. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex_support: Thanks Sam — can you paste a redacted repro? Roughly how many docs and avg chars per doc? Any change in request headers (auth, content-type)?

sam_jensen: Repro below (sanitized). We send query ~2.2k chars, docs: 180 items, many ~3-5kb text. curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"<long query...>","documents":[{"id":"1","text":"<very long>"}, ...]}'``` Server returns 413 immediately (no partial scores).

alex_support: Got it. Two things to triage: 1) whether request is rejected at ingress LB vs service (fast fail) and 2) whether deploy changed any default input-length guards. Maria, can you check recent rollout?

maria_engineer: deploy-bot shows a config change at 3234498000: api-gateway: increase max_body_bytes from 2MB -> 1.5MB (oops, decreased). That would explain more 413s. I didn't expect that change; looks like a mis-merge in infra PR.

sam_jensen: Interesting — but the error message from the service says "input token ceiling exceeded" which our users found confusing. They think tokens refer to billing/tokenization, not raw bytes.

alex_support: Noted. For immediate mitigation: ask customers to trim docs or send summaries/snippets rather than full doc bodies; or paginate/stream docs and rerank candidates in batches. Also suggest using the "text_snippet" field (we have it in the API) to pass shorter extracts. I'll send a template response.

maria_engineer: I'll roll back that gateway change in the next 10 minutes and add a test to prevent regressions. Also propose we change the 413 payload text to: "request body too large: reduce number/size of documents or send only snippets; see https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank#limits". Clear actionable guidance is better than "input token ceiling exceeded".

alex_support: Draft reply to customer (short): "We're investigating; temporary root cause is an API gateway size limit introduced in a recent config change. Workarounds: send fewer docs, pass document snippets, or batch rerank requests. We'll post an update when fixed. If you can share one failing request (redacted) we'll validate after rollback."

sam_jensen: Thanks — can you also confirm whether auth/billing could cause similar errors? Customer worried it's quota related.

alex_support: 413 is payload size not quota. If it were auth/billing we'd see 401/403/402 with billing messages. But we'll add a line in our message to avoid confusion.

maria_engineer: Rollback complete at 3234500060. Gateway now set back to 3MB. I pushed a tiny hotfix to the error text in staging; will promote after smoke tests.

alex_support: Great. Follow-ups: (1) add monitoring alert on gateway body size config diff, (2) update docs /rerank limits page with example chunking pseudocode and a sample curl that uses snippets, (3) change error payload to include "retriable: false/true" where applicable. I'll open tickets.

sam_jensen: Customer replied: "App works again, thanks. Could we get clearer error messages in future?" I'll mark this resolved but keep thread for doc copy + follow-ups.

maria_engineer: Filed infra ticket INF-4821 for config guard and DOCS-1293 for message + examples. Leaving note to update SDKs with helpers for chunking.

alex_support: Thanks everyone. I'll post final customer-facing text once DOCS-1293 draft is ready. :thumbsup:
